usedFor: Ascora holds jobs, quotes and enquiries, and Google Docs records each “New Job” through “Add or Replace Text In Tab”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Job” in Ascora, then “Add or Replace Text In Tab” in Google Docs
bestTemplate.why: Each new job lands in a doc tab the moment Ascora creates it.

watchOut: “Add or Replace Text In Tab” can replace a tab's content, so aim “Job Modified” runs at the right tab.
